title: The Lost Prize Pony
blurb: The giant plush pony from the top shelf of the prize booth has gone missing. Follow the fluff and bring it home!

hooks.title: An Empty Top Shelf
text: The top shelf of the prize booth is empty!
{prize}, the giant plush pony, is gone.

choices.label: Look for clues
choices.text: {hero} finds a trail of pink fluff leading out the back.

deed.text: found the trail of pink fluff

choices.label: Give a big hug
choices.text: {ally} sniffles: "I saw {villain} hanging around all day!"

deed.text: cheered up {ally} with a big hug

hooks.title: A Cheeky Note
text: Where the pony used to sit, there is a note.
"Too fluffy to give away. Signed, a secret."

choices.label: After the thief!
choices.text: Everyone dashes off before the ink is even dry.

deed.text: dashed off after the pony thief

choices.label: Study the handwriting
choices.text: {hero} squints. Those loopy letters belong to {villain}!

deed.text: matched the thief's loopy handwriting

beats.title: Sticky Hoofprints
text: Sticky little hoofprints lead through the toffee stand.
Someone dragged a very big pony through here.

callbacks.text: {who} {deed}, and it leads straight to the toffee.

choices.label: Follow the stickiness
choices.text: {hero} follows the prints. Squelch, squelch.

game.intro: Do not get stuck in the toffee!

win.text: {winner} finds a golden pony shoe stuck in the toffee.

deed.text: pulled a pony shoe out of the toffee

lose.text: {loser} gets one shoe stuck and hops out on the other.

deed.text: lost a shoe in the toffee

choices.label: Help clean up
choices.text: {hero} grabs a mop. {ally} is very grateful.

win.text: {winner} mops the floor and finds a ticket stub signed by {villain}.

deed.text: mopped up the toffee stand

lose.text: {loser} gets the mop stuck to the ceiling. Somehow.

deed.text: stuck a mop to the ceiling

beats.title: Hide in the Petting Pen
text: In the petting pen, there is one goat too many.
It is pink, fluffy and very, very big.

choices.label: Check every goat
choices.text: Everyone tiptoes from goat to goat.

game.intro: Which goat is not a goat?

win.text: {winner} finds it! Just a goat in a pink wig. But it has a clue in its mouth.

deed.text: unmasked a goat in a pink wig

lose.text: {loser} gets their hat eaten by a goat. It was a nice hat.

deed.text: fed their hat to a goat

choices.label: Hand out carrots
choices.text: {hero} offers carrots. The goats crowd round, happy.

win.text: {winner} feeds them all. One goat coughs up a clue. Lovely.

deed.text: fed every goat in the petting pen

lose.text: {loser} is chased round the pen by a very keen goat.

deed.text: was chased by a keen goat

beats.title: Down the Big Slide
text: A pink blur whooshes down the Big Slide.
Someone at the top shouts "Wheee!" and runs off.

choices.label: Slide after it!
choices.text: {hero} grabs a sack and leaps onto the slide.

win.text: {winner} lands first and catches a fluffy pony tail.

deed.text: zoomed down the Big Slide

lose.text: {loser} slides down backwards, waving the whole way.

deed.text: slid down the Big Slide backwards

choices.label: Climb to the top
choices.text: From the top, {hero} can see the whole fair.

win.text: {winner} spots {villain} sneaking off with something pink.

deed.text: spotted the thief from the top of the slide

lose.text: {loser} gets bumped by a sack and slides down anyway.

deed.text: slid down the slide by surprise

beats.title: The Ring-Toss Trick
text: At the ring toss, every bottle is a little too wide.
"Win a ring, win a clue!" grins the stall cat.

callbacks.text: {who} {deed}. Every clue points to this stall.

choices.label: Toss the rings
choices.text: {hero} rolls up both sleeves and picks up the rings.

win.text: CLINK! {winner} rings the big bottle. Inside: a map of the fair.

deed.text: won the ring toss fair and square

lose.text: {loser} rings the stall cat. It purrs and keeps the ring.

deed.text: put a ring on the stall cat

choices.label: Point out the trick
choices.text: {hero} measures a bottle with a pencil. Too wide!

win.text: {winner} proves the trick. The cat gives up the map, embarrassed.

deed.text: caught the ring-toss trick

lose.text: {loser} measures the cat by mistake. It is one pencil long.

deed.text: measured a cat with a pencil

beats.title: Bumper Boat Chase
text: {villain} zooms off in a bumper boat.
The pony is sitting in the back, wearing a life ring!

choices.label: Jump in a boat!
choices.text: Everyone piles into bumper boats. Splash!

game.intro: Bump your way across the pond!

text: {winner} bumps {villain}'s boat into the reeds!
The thief hops out and runs.

deed.text: bumped the thief's boat into the reeds

lose.text: {loser} goes round in circles, very happily.

deed.text: steered a bumper boat in circles

choices.label: Fish out a clue
choices.text: Something floats behind the thief's boat. {hero} grabs a net.

win.text: {winner} nets a soggy note: "Meet at the Ferris wheel. Bring the pony."

deed.text: fished a secret note out of the pond

lose.text: {loser} catches an old boot. It fits, too.

deed.text: fished up an old boot

beats.title: Hoops for Hints
text: {ally} runs the hoop-shot stall tonight.
"Score big and I will tell you what I saw!"

choices.label: Shoot some hoops
choices.text: {hero} bounces the ball twice. Swish time.

text: {winner} scores big!
{ally} whispers: the pony went to the Ferris wheel!

deed.text: sank the winning hoop shot

lose.text: {loser}'s ball bounces off a hot dog stand and comes right back.

deed.text: bounced a ball off a hot dog stand

choices.label: Help run the stall
choices.text: Everyone helps hand out balls to the queue.

win.text: {winner} catches the most. {ally} grins and tells you everything.

deed.text: helped {ally} run the hoop stall

lose.text: {loser} is buried under a heap of bouncy balls.

deed.text: got buried in bouncy balls

beats.title: The Costume Tent
text: The costume tent is full of pony costumes.
One of them is walking around by itself!

choices.label: Dress up and blend in
choices.text: Everyone pulls on a pony costume. Neigh!

text: {winner} neighs so well the walking costume trots over.
It is {villain}'s helper!

deed.text: fooled a pony thief with a perfect neigh

lose.text: {loser} puts the costume on back to front. A pony with two tails!

deed.text: wore a pony costume back to front

choices.label: Count the costumes
choices.text: {hero} counts. Twelve hooks, thirteen costumes. Hmm.

game.intro: Find the costume that does not belong!

win.text: {winner} pulls off the extra costume. It is {villain}'s helper, giggling.

deed.text: counted the costumes and caught a helper

lose.text: {loser} counts themselves as a costume. Fourteen!

deed.text: counted themselves as a costume

beats.title: Over the Ferris Wheel
text: At the very top of the Ferris wheel, something pink.
{prize}'s fluffy head is peeking out of a seat!

callbacks.text: {who} {deed}, so you knew to come straight here.

choices.label: Ride up and grab it
choices.text: Everyone squeezes into one seat. Up you go!

game.intro: Jump seats at just the right time!

win.text: {winner} leaps across and hugs the pony. But it is only a pony-shaped pillow!

deed.text: rescued a pony-shaped pillow

lose.text: {loser} rides round three times waving at everyone.

deed.text: waved from the Ferris wheel three times

choices.label: Stop the wheel
choices.text: {hero} finds the big wheel's control box.

win.text: {winner} stops the wheel. It was a decoy! But the stuffing points to the Big Top.

deed.text: worked the Ferris wheel controls

lose.text: {loser} presses the music button. The wheel plays a polka.

deed.text: made the Ferris wheel play a polka

beats.title: The Wobbly Funhouse
text: Giggles echo from inside the funhouse.
The floor wobbles. The pony's hooves stick out of a barrel.

callbacks.text: {who} {deed}. A wobbly floor will not stop you now.

choices.label: Run the rolling barrel
choices.text: {hero} hops into the spinning barrel.

win.text: {winner} rolls out holding a fistful of pony mane. Getting close!

deed.text: ran the rolling barrel

lose.text: {loser} rolls out the other end like a sausage.

deed.text: rolled out of the barrel like a sausage

choices.label: Ask it nicely
choices.text: "Whoever is in there, we just want to talk!"

text: {winner}'s kind words work!
{villain}'s helper waves a sock and points the way.

deed.text: talked a helper out of the funhouse

lose.text: {loser} says "please" so many times it becomes a song.

deed.text: turned "please" into a song

choices.label: Send in the goats
choices.text: The goats from the petting pen trot in, very curious.

win.text: {winner} follows the goats to a hidden room full of pony fluff.

deed.text: led a goat search through the funhouse

lose.text: {loser} ends up wearing a goat. Well, holding one.

deed.text: carried a goat around the funhouse

beats.title: The Getaway Wagon
text: A wagon piled with prizes creaks toward the gate.
On top sits a heap of teddies. And one pink ear.

callbacks.text: {who} {deed}. Disguises do not fool you anymore.

choices.label: Chase the wagon
choices.text: Everyone sprints after the creaking wagon.

win.text: {winner} catches up and puts on the brake. Creeeak. Stop!

deed.text: stopped the getaway wagon

lose.text: {loser} is bopped by a falling teddy. Soft, at least.

deed.text: was bopped by a flying teddy

choices.label: Sort the prizes
choices.text: {hero} starts handing prizes back to kids in the crowd.

game.intro: Give each prize to the right owner!

win.text: {winner} returns every prize. The wagon is empty, except for a trail of pink fluff.

deed.text: returned every stolen prize

lose.text: {loser} gives a goldfish to a grandad. He loves it.

deed.text: gave a grandad a goldfish

interludes.title: A Rainbow Sprinkle
text: A single rainbow sprinkle sparkles on the path.
It smells just like {prize}.

choices.label: Keep it for luck
choices.text: {hero} pockets the sprinkle. It tingles.

deed.text: found a lucky rainbow sprinkle

choices.label: Share a snack
choices.text: Sprinkles on everyone's ice cream!

deed.text: shared rainbow sprinkles with everyone

any: {ally} runs up holding a giant carrot.
"For the celebration. You WILL find it!"

choices.label: Take it along
choices.text: Everyone thanks {ally}. Onward!

deed.text: took a gift from {ally}

choices.label: Wear it on your head
choices.text: {hero} balances it on their head like a crown.

deed.text: wore {ally}'s gift as a crown

climax.title: Showdown in the Big Top
text: Under the Big Top, {villain} hugs {prize} tight.
"It's MINE! I never win anything at the ring toss!"

callbacks.text: {who} {deed}, so {villain} has nowhere left to hide.

extra.text: {villain}'s helper waves at you. They are on your side now.

choices.label: Tug-of-war together
choices.text: Everyone grabs the pony's tail. Ready, heave!

win.text: Pop! {prize} comes free and {villain} lands in the sawdust, laughing.

deed.text: won the great pony tug-of-war

lose.text: {villain} hangs on and bounces away on the trampolines.

deed.text: pulled hard on a pony's tail

choices.label: Win one for them
choices.text: {hero} says: "Let's win YOU a prize, fair and square."

game.intro: Win {villain} a prize of their own!

text: {winner} wins {villain} a tiny pony. Happy tears!
{prize} goes home.

deed.text: won {villain} a prize of their own

lose.text: {loser} wins a rubber chicken. {villain} loves it anyway.

deed.text: won a rubber chicken

climax.title: Up, Up and Away
text: {villain} ties {prize} to a bunch of balloons!
The pony starts floating up over the fair.

callbacks.text: {who} {deed}. Heights are no problem for this party.

extra.text: The lucky sprinkle tingles. The wind is on your side!

choices.label: Pop the balloons
choices.text: Everyone grabs a pea-shooter. Gently now!

game.intro: Pop the balloons one by one!

win.text: Pop, pop, pop! {prize} floats down softly into everyone's arms.

deed.text: floated {prize} gently back to the ground

lose.text: {prize} drifts off over the trees. {villain} waves bye-bye.

deed.text: almost caught a flying pony

choices.label: Climb the tent pole
choices.text: {hero} starts shinning up the tallest tent pole.

win.text: {winner} grabs the string at the top and lowers {prize} down safe.

deed.text: caught {prize} from the top of the Big Top

lose.text: {loser} grabs a balloon and floats up a little. Then down. Boing.

deed.text: floated on a balloon for a bit

any: {prize} is back on the top shelf, fluffier than ever.
{villain} now helps out at the prize booth.
Hooray! The giant pony is home.
Everyone gets a ride on its back before the fair opens.
But the prize booth has a new sign: WATCH THIS SHELF.
The top shelf is still empty tonight.
Somewhere, a giant pony is having a lovely adventure.

lines.text: {villain} carries that tiny pony everywhere now.
The petting pen goats get carrots every Sunday.
Every kid at the fair has their prize back, too.
{ally} throws a party in your honour.
